def geometry_ref
  {O : Type} (OpsInst : Ops O) (queries : Array Std.U32 22#usize)
  (start : Std.Usize) (end1 : Std.Usize) :
  Result (core.result.Result Geometry Std.U8)
  := do
  if start > end1
  then ok (core.result.Result.Err 1#u8)
  else
    if end1 > 22#usize
    then ok (core.result.Result.Err 1#u8)
    else
      let i ← end1 - start
      let zs := alloc.vec.Vec.with_capacity Std.U32 i
      let i1 ← i * 5#usize
      let flat := alloc.vec.Vec.with_capacity Std.U32 i1
      let s ←
        core.array.Array.index (core.ops.index.IndexSlice
          (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice Std.U32)) queries
          { start, «end» := end1 }
      let iter ←

          s
      geometry_ref_loop0 OpsInst iter start zs flat
